Energy & Inputs.title: Will Crude Oil reach a new all-time high by December 31?
Energy & Inputs.event_title: Crude Oil all time high by...?
Energy & Inputs.why_it_matters: Tail-risk bet (12% odds) on crude reaching a new all-time high. Closes in ~1mo. Would lift farm diesel and pass through to nitrogen fertilizer cost within a few months.

Energy & Inputs.title: Will Crude Oil reach a new all-time high by March 31, 2027?
Energy & Inputs.event_title: Crude Oil all time high by...?
Energy & Inputs.why_it_matters: Lower-probability outcome (26%) of crude reaching a new all-time high. Closes in ~4mo. Would lift farm diesel and pass through to nitrogen fertilizer cost within a few months.

Economy & Markets.title: Will the Fed increase interest rates by 25 bps after the December 2026 meeting?
Economy & Markets.why_it_matters: Fed policy moves ripple through the dollar and farm lending -- 78% YES on this outcome.

Economy & Markets.title: Will there be no change in Fed interest rates after the December 2026 meeting?
Economy & Markets.why_it_matters: Fed policy moves ripple through the dollar and farm lending -- 22% YES on this outcome.

Economy & Markets.title: Will the Fed increase interest rates by 50+ bps after the December 2026 meeting?
Economy & Markets.why_it_matters: Fed policy moves ripple through the dollar and farm lending -- 1% YES on this outcome.

Economy & Markets.title: Will no Fed rate cuts happen in 2026?
Economy & Markets.event_title: How many Fed rate cuts in 2026?
Economy & Markets.why_it_matters: 97% odds of NO rate cut over the contract window. Rates holding where they are keeps operating-loan and land-carrying cost at today's level and leaves the dollar without that source of downward pressure.
